description: Historical source-assertion inquiry over an explicit analyst/case period. Supplied-source correction reports are retained; history beyond that scope is unknown. No current or unwithdrawn-status assurance, publisher claim about neighbours, risk score, ownership or accepted assessment.

seed.description: Exact source identity; labels alone cannot supply joins.

period.description: Resolved analyst/case UTC dates selecting actual source-claim applicability, not receipt.

period_origin.description: Recorded origin of the selected range.

claim_kind.description: The particular source claim under inquiry.

reference_sources.description: Explicit supplied source/revision scope; does not certify complete correction history.

apply_exclusions.description: Apply explicitly selected investigation exclusions; shared-host classification alone is context.

scope_limit.literal: listed subject associated with ASN for this claim; not an ASN-wide publisher assertion or individual observations of every address
